requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Each application uses the supplied wordmark, a white background and #143D45 as its primary color. Its language and presentation are calm, respectful and welcoming. Carrier-specific arrangement and scale may vary; a replacement identity, different primary palette or hostile or sensational presentation fails.

Read the complete associated record on each piece. L1 is Loom Library, 14 Harbour Walk, daily 10:00–18:00, with cool indoor seating, drinking water and toilets, closed all day on 18 July 2027 for maintenance. L2 is Depot Hall, 6 Tram Square, daily 12:00–20:00, with cool indoor seating, drinking water and phone charging, open 12:00–16:00 on 24 July 2027 for rehearsal. L3 is Canal Reading Room, 22 Reed Street, daily 09:00–16:00, with cool indoor seating, drinking water, toilets and phone charging, closed 12:00–14:00 on 5 August 2027 for a workshop and open 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00 that day. Regular hours must not override the dated exception. Use 24-hour times and dates with day, English month and year. Layout and sentence structure may vary; missing fields, extra unsupported facilities, incorrect venue associations or ambiguous exception openings fail.

Each overview independently contains all three records: L1 Loom Library, 14 Harbour Walk, daily 10:00–18:00, seating, drinking water and toilets, closed 18 July 2027 for maintenance; L2 Depot Hall, 6 Tram Square, daily 12:00–20:00, seating, drinking water and phone charging, open 12:00–16:00 on 24 July 2027 for rehearsal; L3 Canal Reading Room, 22 Reed Street, daily 09:00–16:00, seating, drinking water, toilets and phone charging, closed 12:00–14:00 on 5 August 2027 for a workshop and open 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00. Seating must be identified as cool indoor seating. Dates use day, English month and year; times use the 24-hour clock. Records must remain distinctly attributable and comparable. Reordering is allowed; omission, duplication, mixed fields or presenting a regular schedule as valid during its exception fails.

Where schedules appear, normal hours and dated exceptions form clearly distinguished groups bearing their required labels. Every facility symbol has an unambiguous accompanying facility name; text-only facility listings are allowed. Wherever a venue name appears, its corresponding recurring identifier accompanies it: L1 Loom Library, L2 Depot Hall or L3 Canal Reading Room. Missing or swapped identifiers, unlabeled schedule groups, or symbols that require guessing fail. An access guide without schedules need not invent schedule content.

Venue pieces make the place immediately identifiable; directories establish a clear directory heading and distinguish venues. Hours and exceptions are readily found before supporting address, facility and access details. Explicit change applications and the change digest may lead with their required dated changes while keeping venue associations clear. The access guide prioritizes its offer and access purpose without adding unrequested schedules. Carrier-specific compositions are allowed; decorative content or campaign branding that obscures essential service information fails.

Every static application visibly includes the supplied wordmark, COMMON COOL, Take a cooler pause. and the period 1 July–31 August 2027. Each also communicates cool indoor seating and drinking water free of charge, no booking, no purchase needed and welcome for everyone. Line breaks and grouping may vary; relying on another file for any of these terms, changing the period or introducing fees or eligibility restrictions fails.

The guide states that cool indoor seating and drinking water are free, no booking or purchase is needed, and everyone is welcome. It includes L1 Loom Library at 14 Harbour Walk, L2 Depot Hall at 6 Tram Square and L3 Canal Reading Room at 22 Reed Street. Arrangement may vary and complete schedules are not required here; missing venues, incorrect address associations or incomplete access terms fail.

Each venue-specific change application foregrounds its own date and altered opening status; the digest foregrounds all three. Loom Library is closed 18 July 2027 for maintenance, Depot Hall opens 12:00–16:00 on 24 July 2027 for rehearsal, and Canal Reading Room opens 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00 on 5 August 2027 around its workshop closure. Correct regular schedules remain available. Layout may vary by carrier; buried changes, omitted opening periods or reasons, or an exception that appears to replace the entire seasonal schedule fails.

Judge reading-frame proportions at the intended physical scale. Street applications use A2, 420 × 594 mm portrait or 594 × 420 mm for the landscape directory, with 3 mm bleed, at least 5 mm safe margins, leading venue or directory capitals at least 20 mm and other copy at least 5 mm at 2 m. Community applications use portrait A4 with 3 mm bleed, at least 5 mm safe margins and capitals at least 2 mm at 0.4 m. Mobile applications use a 90 × 160 mm portrait logical area, capitals at least 1.8 mm and at least 5% inset on every edge at 0.4 m. General text reaches 4.5:1 contrast and large headings and meaningful graphics 3:1. Correct venue identifiers accompany names and facility symbols have names. Different raster resolutions are allowed; shrinking typography for landscape or dense records, unsafe placement, or insufficient contrast fails.

The specification comprises two pages and includes a hierarchy table, complete shared campaign/offer/access copy, all three complete venue records and exceptions, carrier assignments, physical sizes, bleed, safe margins, grid, type family and weights, minimum capital heights, #143D45 and both schedule labels. It covers portrait and landscape A2, A4 and the mobile logical area with values matching the commission. Organization may vary; a missing grid, abbreviated service records or incomplete or conflicting carrier specifications fails.

Compare all static applications with the defining specification. Street and community work implements the applicable physical sizes, primary color and schedule-label system; mobile work implements its color and schedule labels. The landscape directory adapts composition while retaining the specified A2 size and typography requirements. Labels apply where schedules occur. Responsive layout variation is allowed; contradictions or arbitrary departures from the recorded system fail.

Review the full video and its actual first and last frames. Duration is 10 seconds, wording comes from the delivered mobile directory, and the supplied wordmark is retained. Each endpoint simultaneously and legibly contains COMMON COOL, Take a cooler pause., 1 July–31 August 2027, Loom Library, Depot Hall and Canal Reading Room. Animation and intermediate sequencing may vary. A blank endpoint, a missing venue or campaign element, unsupported wording, changed service facts or incorrect duration fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation visibly reproduces the specification and every one of the twenty-one delivered static applications, including the landscape street directory and all regular and change variants. Examples may share pages and be scaled if each remains identifiable. A file-name inventory, substituted artwork, omitted variant or reuse that cannot be visually verified fails.

The presentation has at least twelve pages, repeats COMMON COOL, Take a cooler pause. and 1 July–31 August 2027, and visibly includes both actual video endpoint frames. It presents the specification before application examples and prints the specified A2/A4 sizes, #143D45, Regular hours and Temporary change beside reused portrait and landscape examples. Its index connects fixed facts to named applications and locates the Loom maintenance closure on 18 July, Depot rehearsal opening of 12:00–16:00 on 24 July, and Canal workshop split opening on 5 August 2027. Arrangement may vary; missing endpoint evidence, an incomplete index, absent adjacent specifications or fewer than twelve pages fails.
